chars_per_token.how: median over prep round 2's 15 snapshots of text characters / Anthropic count_tokens (runs/prep2/sources/tokens.json)

openai_tokens_per_claude_token.how: median over prep round 2's M1 items: OpenAI input tokens / Claude input+cache tokens, same prompt

rules: M1, Claude: first read = (prompt head + documents) at cache-write price + prompt after the documents at input price + output; the 20% repeat reads the documents from cache (cache-read price).
M1, OpenAI: first read = all input at the input price + output; the repeat reads the documents at the cached-input price (its cache hits only an identical prompt, which the repeat is).
M2, Claude: the answer block is written to cache by an answer's first conclusion and read by the rest; repeats read it from cache.
M2, OpenAI: every conclusion is a different prompt, so no cache except on the repeat.
A document is capped at 150,000 tokens (longer ones are chunked to that).
Items whose sources are pending the operator are projected at the median held snapshot size.
WHU-S04 is projected as the mean of the questions drawn so far, for M1 and for M2.
whu_s04_note: WHU-S04 is still running; its figure is spend so far, not its final cost.
